```{=html}
<!-- Navbar -->
{{< include _navbar.html >}}

<!-- Page content -->
<div class="auth-page">
  <div class="auth-card">
    <img src="assets/logo.png" alt="AAIC Logo" class="auth-logo">
    <h2>Student Log In</h2>
    <p class="auth-subtitle">Enter your username to continue</p>
    <div id="errorMsg" class="auth-error" style="display:none;"></div>
    <form id="studentLoginForm" onsubmit="return false;">
      <label for="username">Username</label>
      <input type="text" id="username" placeholder="Enter your username" required>
      <button type="submit" class="auth-btn" id="loginBtn">Log In</button>
    </form>

    <!-- Forgot username link -->
    <div class="auth-links" style="margin-top: 1rem;">
      <a href="#" id="forgotUsernameLink" style="color: #006C93; font-weight: 600;">Forgot your username?</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Forgot username popup -->
<div id="forgotUsernamePopup" style="display:none; position:fixed; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5); z-index:10000; align-items:center; justify-content:center;">
  <div style="position:relative; background:#fff; border-radius:16px; padding:2.5rem 2rem 2rem 2rem; max-width:420px; width:90%; box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); text-align:center;">
    <button id="closeForgotPopup" style="position:absolute; top:0.6rem; right:0.8rem; background:none; border:2px solid #006C93; border-radius:50%; width:32px; height:32px; font-size:1.2rem; color:#006C93; cursor:pointer; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; line-height:1; padding:0; transition:all 0.25s ease;"
      onmouseover="this.style.background='linear-gradient(135deg, #00746F 0%, #006C93 100%)'; this.style.color='#fff'; this.style.borderColor='#00746F';"
      onmouseout="this.style.background='none'; this.style.color='#006C93'; this.style.borderColor='#006C93';"
    >&times;</button>
    <h3 style="color:#006C93; font-size:1.3rem; margin:0 0 0.75rem 0;">Forgot Your Username?</h3>
    <p style="color:#58595B; font-size:1rem; line-height:1.6; margin:0;">Ask your teacher for your credentials.</p>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
// Student login handler
document.getElementById('studentLoginForm').addEventListener('submit', async function () {
  var btn = document.getElementById('loginBtn');
  var errorMsg = document.getElementById('errorMsg');
  var username = document.getElementById('username').value.trim();

  if (!username) return;

  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = 'Logging in...';
  errorMsg.style.display = 'none';

  try {
    var response = await _supabase.functions.invoke('student-login', {
      body: { username: username }
    });

    if (response.error) throw new Error(response.error.message || 'Login failed');
    if (response.data && response.data.error) throw new Error(response.data.error);

    var session = response.data.session;
    if (!session) throw new Error('Login failed. Please try again.');

    var setResult = await _supabase.auth.setSession({
      access_token: session.access_token,
      refresh_token: session.refresh_token
    });
    if (setResult.error) throw setResult.error;

    window.location.href = 'student-hub.html';
  } catch (err) {
    errorMsg.textContent = err.message;
    errorMsg.style.display = 'block';
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.textContent = 'Log In';
  }
});

// Forgot username popup handlers
document.getElementById('forgotUsernameLink').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  document.getElementById('forgotUsernamePopup').style.display = 'flex';
});

document.getElementById('closeForgotPopup').addEventListener('click', function() {
  document.getElementById('forgotUsernamePopup').style.display = 'none';
});

// Close popup when clicking the dark overlay background
document.getElementById('forgotUsernamePopup').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (e.target === this) {
    this.style.display = 'none';
  }
});
</script>
```
